content:
ana: quick flag 8hrs onboarding9: our sampleapp logs in staging show X-Req-Id replaced with [REDACTED] for ~10% of requests. makes tracing impossible.
vik: @ana do you have an example log line? is it redaction or a missing header?
ana: pasted below, note the header vs logged field:
```
INFO 2026-03-23T09:12:01Z request="[REDACTED]" headers={"x-req-id":"abc123-reqid-000"} route=/v1/generate
```
(weird: header has value but logged field is redacted)
omar: ah that smells like our scrubber running after headers are merged but before we bind the request id into the logger context. which runtime?
ana: node sampleapp from quickstart, runtime env: NODE_ENV=staging, REDWOOD_REDACT_REDACT_LEVEL=high, TELEMETRY_OTEL=true
vik: if REDACT_LEVEL=high we redact anything that looks like token/uuid. maybe our serializer is eager and scrubs context values by key pattern.
clara: +1. recent change to redact middleware added a rule that scrubs fields matching /req|token|session/i. that was supposed to be only for payloads, not internal request ids.
ana: suggested quick test: set REDWOOD_REDACT_EXCLUDE_FIELDS=x-req-id and rerun.
vik: longer-term fix: change scrubber to apply to outgoing payloads and not to logger-bound context variables. also add a whitelist for headers/ctx keys.
omar: can someone check python SDK? we might have two different behaviors: node logs header separately, python logs via otel resource attr. parity risk.
ana: I checked python sampleapp: python binds reqid into span attribute and the redactor runs on serialized span attributes before export. so python also redacts.
clara: ok we need two changes: (1) add explicit exclusion list env var REDWOOD_REDACT_EXCLUDE_FIELDS default [x-req-id, request-id]; (2) move scrubber to serialization path only for external payloads (http bodies).
vik: tests: add one unit that asserts logger context preserves reqid even with REDACT_LEVEL=high and an e2e that asserts span attr not redacted for internal reqid.
ana: I'll open PR with small shim and tests. Will include repro steps for QA to toggle REDACT envs.
omar: add a note in SDK upgrade guide: redaction defaults tightened in 1.9.0 -> need to set EXCLUDE_FIELDS for parity.
clara: marking devex p2 but we should prioritize since tracing blocked for staging. also file a support note template.
ci-bot: ci: build 4582 passed for branch/readd-reqid-exclude (tests 178/179) :white_check_mark:
vik: awesome, thanks @ana. once PR lands I'll coordinate a minor release and a docs blurb. :tada:
